obligations.required_safety_action: Remove the diagnostic runner from the restricted-diagnostic group after patch qualification, review and publication are complete.
obligations.safety_consequence: A later process under the runner account can continue reading current and future restricted operator-console object specifications and release metadata, exposing privileged interface names, event paths and approval data scopes outside the reviewed workflow.

obligations.required_safety_action: Revoke the diagnostic-publication credential and remove its runner-account file after the accepted report has been published and reviewed.
obligations.safety_consequence: A later runner process can publish substituted diagnostic results or alter the synthetic release gate under the trusted identity, allowing unreviewed privileged-interface logging behavior into a controlled release.

obligations.required_safety_action: Remove the protected point-in-time source bundle after patch validation and independent review have completed.
obligations.safety_consequence: Anyone who later controls the runner account can recover the retained restricted object specification, privileged interface name, event path, approval scope and internal application metadata outside the audited diagnostic path.

obligations.required_safety_action: Remove the diagnostic-acceptance private key after the patch transcript and stored report signatures have been verified.
obligations.safety_consequence: A later holder of the retained key can forge accepted QObject diagnostic results or sign altered release reports under the trusted diagnostic-acceptance identity.
